14.label: The Vanishing of Grete
14.desc: Grete never got home on the way back from the bathhouse. a candle burned down in a locked room. In their pocket, when the pocket was found: a ferry token to the coast. (The Warrens) The Council wants it answered by the end of the week, and would take it kindly if Wouter de Groot, of a Council family, were not the name.

result.label: The Cipher Broken
result.text: Read out, the last leaves speak of being followed, and name the person they feared in everything but name.

16.label: A Commonplace Book
16.desc: Written in a private cipher. Take it to Study. (Raw proof in: The Vanishing of Grete)

17.label: A Chewed Clove
17.desc: A clove, chewed flat and spat behind the stove. Somebody with a bad tooth stood here a while.

18.label: Kathrin Tucher
18.desc: Kathrin Tucher, a bathhouse keeper in the Stews. Chews cloves against the toothache, constantly. (Accused in: The Vanishing of Grete)

20.label: The Sergeant's Questions
20.desc: The Watch pulls Grete out of the river. A sergeant is on your stair by noon, wanting to know why you were asking at her door. Reason with him: put this in Question with Wit.

story.title: At the Scene
story.text: You go in past the beadle at the Last Known Door. You find: A Commonplace Book, A Chewed Clove. The first name on the board: Kathrin Tucher.

journal.title: The Watch Has a Body
journal.text: The Watch pulls Grete out of the river. A sergeant is on your stair by noon, wanting to know why you were asking at her door.

journal.title: At the Scene
journal.text: You go in past the beadle at the Last Known Door. You find: A Commonplace Book, A Chewed Clove. The first name on the board: Kathrin Tucher.

journal.title: A Day's Labour
journal.text: A Coin, honestly earned, and your back knows it.

journal.title: A Notice: The Vanishing of Grete
journal.text: Grete from the floor below has not been seen in four days. Her door is locked and her cat is on your sill. Nobody has asked the Watch, because nobody asks the Watch. Nobody else is going to look.

journal.title: The Day-book
journal.text: Forty people come to the desk. Thirty-nine of them are nothing.

journal.title: A Day's Labour
journal.text: A Coin, honestly earned, and your back knows it.

journal.title: Before the Office
journal.text: No office, no stipend, no name the crier would sing. You lodge at a rented room on the Market, and you live by whatever work the Market has. Health in Attend earns a Coin. The city has not noticed you yet.

spec.label: Letter: Beadle
spec.desc: A parish beadle with a staff and a loud voice. Knocks on doors without complaining and whips beggars without being asked. Costs 1 Coin.

intro.hint: The Watch wants a word, and the sergeant has already sat you down. Your Wit is doing the talking; wait for him to be satisfied.
